Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!
We're looking for a proactive and detail-oriented People Operations Coordinator to join our global People Ops team. In this role, you'll play a key part in executing employee lifecycle processes — everything from onboarding new hires to coordinating off boarding processes. You'll bring strong organizational skills, a knack for problem-solving, and a passion for creating a seamless employee experience.
This is a full time role based in our San Francisco Hub.

Manage US onboarding and off boarding processes including HR system workflows, background checks, I9 checks, and communications
Assist with bi-weekly in person onboarding in our SF hub by welcoming new hires and managing logistics
Serve as the first point of contact for People related questions including onboarding, HR data, benefits, and verifications of employment
Partner with key stakeholders including IT and Payroll to onboard new hires and keep information up to date
Support processing employee changes including compensation, relocation, and manager changes
Provide support for managing global time off and time and attendance
Maintain and organize internal documentation; regularly review and update documentation to reflect changing processes
Manage HR team compliance efforts to ensure adherence to all federal and state labor laws
Assist with projects within the people team

s.h: Entry-level role — no prior HR experience required
s.t:
A customer service mentality - you are focused on providing a great employee experience
Experience managing multiple priorities and shifting deadlines—you are excited to work in a high growth, ambiguous environment
Impeccable attention to detail - you take pride in data integrity, streamlined processes, and timely responses
Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and maintain a high level of professionalism and confidentiality
At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
Pay Transparency Disclosure
Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location.
Figma offers equity to employees, as well as a competitive package of additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits with company contributions; parental leave and reproductive or family planning support; mental health and wellness benefits; and paid time off.

Figma provides paid sick leave, holidays, and other leave benefits in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the requirements of the Washington Minimum Wage Act and related regulations. For non-exempt employees, PTO is accrued at a rate equivalent to 15 days per year for full‑time employees.

Accrued PTO may be used for vacation or personal time, subject to company policy and manager approval. In addition, the company provides 10 paid sick days annually for non-exempt full-time employees. Additional benefits may include company recharge days, cell phone and home internet reimbursements, and a number of lifestyle spending accounts.

Figma also offers sales incentive compensation for most sales roles and an annual bonus plan for eligible non-sales roles. All compensation and benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and may be modified by Figma at any time, consistent with applicable law.

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Employee Experience team exists to help Airbnb become the company that it needs to be.
The Regional Workplace Operations Manager sits at the intersection of workplace experience, events, and gathering & culture. This role is responsible for bringing our brand to life by creating an intentional, welcoming, and high-functioning office experience that enables employees, leaders, and guests to feel connected, productive, and inspired.

Just like our hosts can offer differentiated experiences to our guests, our Regional Workplace Operations Manager exemplifies those aspirational expectations.
This role serves as the connective tissue across office operations, hospitality, employee engagement, and local community experience. They partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders including Talent, IT, Security, Communications, Executive Support, and local leaders to ensure each office reflects Airbnb’s culture and values in a meaningful and scalable way. They integrate platform hosts in the day to day office experience spotlighting service and experience hosts as appropriate.

As the Regional Workplace Operations Manager, you are the primary steward of the employee and guest experience within your office. You create a hospitality-forward environment where people feel welcomed, supported, and connected to Airbnb and each other.
You will oversee the daily office experience while also leading local gathering and engagement efforts that strengthen culture and community. You will direct and coordinate embedded vendors and operational partners to ensure seamless execution across hospitality, food, facilities, and events. You will provide oversight and mentorship to Office Managers within your region, ensuring consistency of standards and experience across proximate offices.
Success in this role requires strong operational ownership, exceptional interpersonal instincts, creativity, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while balancing both strategic thinking and hands-on execution.
You must have your finger on the pulse and anticipate the needs of each guest.

Lead Through Hospitality
Maintain a visible, approachable, and highly responsive presence within the office community.
Create a warm, thoughtful, and highly responsive environment where employees and visitors feel genuinely welcomed and cared for.
Lead with calmness, flexibility, and attention to detail while balancing multiple priorities and adapting to changing business needs.
Support and guide vendors and partners to operate as one cohesive hospitality team in service of the office community.
Drive Operational Excellence
Establish and maintain office operating standards that ensure consistency of hospitality, communication, service delivery, and workplace experience.
Monitor office utilization, employee feedback, operational performance, and service quality to identify opportunities for improvement.
Contribute local insights and best practices that help shape the evolution of workplace standards across the broader portfolio.
Develop repeatable processes and playbooks that enable scalable, high-quality office experiences.
Own the Office Experience
Oversee the holistic daily office experience, ensuring the space operates smoothly and delivers a welcoming, hospitality-forward environment for employees and guests.
You have a strong sense of ownership. Treat the office as your listing.
Serve as the day-to-day steward of the office environment, ensuring the space is operationally seamless, hospitality-forward, and consistently ready to support great work, connection, and high-visibility moments.
Provide operational oversight and direction to on-site vendors and service partners.
Direct and orchestrate on-site vendors and operational vendors including food, facilities, events, and hospitality to ensure consistent service delivery and experience quality. Own escalation management and drive resolution
Partner closely with Security, IT and other operational teams to ensure seamless day-to-day operations.
Act as the “Voice of the Office,” helping employees navigate the workplace experience and ensuring the office feels connected, informed, and supported.
Monitor employee sentiment and proactively identify opportunities to improve the office experience, communication, and engagement.
Enable Gathering & Engagement Experiences
Ensure the office is consistently prepared to support high-visibility visits, events, and business moments.
Partner with Regional Gathering Programs to support successful delivery of offsites, leadership visits and strategic gatherings.
Provide local stakeholder coordination, hospitality leadership, vendor management, and onsite execution support as needed.
Support onsite execution for local events, offsites, and engagement activities, ensuring thoughtful hospitality, operational excellence, and strong attendee experience.
Adapt office experiences to local needs while maintaining consistency with Airbnb culture and values.
Build Strong Partnerships
Develop strong relationships with local leaders, executive admins, Airfinity groups, cross-functional partners and other key stakeholders.
Act as a trusted partner and connector across teams, helping identify opportunities to strengthen office culture, engagement, and employee experience.
Partner with leaders to support meaningful moments of connection within the office and across teams.

6–9+ years of experience in workplace experience, hospitality, events, employee engagement, operations, or related fields
Experience owning and executing programs, events, or operational experiences end-to-end
Strong hospitality mindset with a passion for creating thoughtful and high-quality experiences
Experience managing vendors, operational partners, or service delivery teams
Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills across diverse teams and leadership levels
Ability to operate autonomously, navigate ambiguity, and manage multiple priorities simultaneously
Strong organizational and operational execution skills with attention to detail
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Experience supporting employee engagement, cultural programming, gatherings, or community-building initiatives is preferred
Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution
Passion for Airbnb’s mission, culture, and values
This role is expected to be based in-office full-time in our Seattle office, with flexibility for occasional evenings or weekends in support of events and gatherings.

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The Finance Operations (FinOps) team provides and enhances core business services that are the backbone of Stripe. FinOps uses data and operational excellence to deliver technology solutions, payroll services, operational excellence, and monetization services to Stripe.

We're looking for a Monetization Operations Analyst to join our growing team. You'll help us improve user experience through accurate and timely onboarding of contracts and workflows, and deliver improvements in our integrated financial systems with business partners, financial colleagues, and engineers.

Onboard sold custom contracts into our billing systems.
Work with legal contracts with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Develop and manage scalable billing and collection processes for complex user agreements and new business operations.
Build scalable and auditable onboarding processes for new and existing users.
Partner with internal systems, global deal management, legal, sales ops, internal audit, go-to-market, engineering, and accounting teams to develop and improve processes for contract reviews and to anticipate changing business requirements.
Partner with account managers to resolve user inquiries related to onboarding implementation, billing, and collections.
Advocate for the customer to internal stakeholders. Share system feedback and insights with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Support, and Legal on innovation and improvements needed to optimize the Stripe user experience.
Help scope, build, and deliver continuous process improvements that enhance operations.

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

5+ years of experience in a client-facing role, ideally in customer success, consulting, financial services, account management, or sales, preferably working with technical products.
Track record of leading technical conversations and persuading others to take action based on requirements and value provided by solutions.
Ability to be detail-oriented while visualizing the larger impact of a series of transactions.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate data and people to find answers.
Strong operating rigor, including organizational and time management skills.
Ability to work well with a wide range of people, both internally and externally, including working with a team of sales and services peers.
Motivation and flexibility to work well in a high-growth environment where things change quickly.

Ability to trace process impacts from situation to end customers and business financial outcomes.
Knowledge of or experience in the payments industry.
Demonstrated professional experience using GSuite, Excel, and working with large data sets.
Experience with SQL.
Demonstrated project management or consulting experience and the ability to work cross-functionally.
A builder's mindset and a willingness to question assumptions and conventional wisdom.
A passion for learning and solving problems through infrastructure and automation.

Join us in building the future of finance.
Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers.

We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Tax Operations team’s mission is to support our tax information reporting and compliance efforts related to the purchase and sale of equities and crypto.

We partner with product, engineering, and account operations teams to ensure robust and scalable tax systems. Our team fosters a highly collaborative, supportive, and execution-oriented culture. We are dedicated to ensuring a seamless tax reporting experience for all Robinhood customers!
Robinhood is looking for a skilled Tax Operations professional to join our team! We are seeking motivated professionals who thrive in dynamic environments and can manage multiple priorities.

In this role, you will lead tax reporting processes for taxable and retirement accounts, executing critical exception reports covering areas such as withholding, cost basis, and crypto transactions. You will also partner with Customer Experience and Account Operations teams to resolve complex tax-related inquiries and withholding issues.
This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week . At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

Collaborate with product, project, and engineering teams to launch, improve, and scale Robinhood products and systems, tracking various tax-related initiatives and new product promotions
Lead the tax reporting processes for taxable and retirement accounts, executing critical exception reports covering areas such as withholding, cost basis, and crypto transactions
Partner with Customer Experience and Account Operations teams to resolve complex tax inquiries, cost basis issues, and withholding discrepancies
Develop and implement reconciliations of data between internal systems and vendors, verifying the accuracy of tax information transmitted to the IRS

Bring a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field, along with 5+ years of professional experience in tax operations
Demonstrate experience with retirement tax reporting, specifically with IRS Forms 1099-R and 5498
Showcase strong analytical and communication skills, with proficiency in tools like SQL or Databricks to manage, mine, and convert large datasets
Manage and drive tax projects to completion in a deadline-driven environment, maintaining high attention to detail
Apply prior experience in Financial Services, Fintech, or Crypto, with an understanding of tax onboarding procedures and Forms W-9/W-8BEN preferred

Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not
Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

Airtable is the no-code app platform that empowers people closest to the work to accelerate their most critical business processes. More than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, rely on Airtable to transform how work gets done.
Join Airtable as a Procurement Operations Manager and help reimagine how procurement gets done at one of the fastest-moving finance organizations in tech. This role owns the day-to-day of a high-velocity procurement function while rebuilding it for an AI-native era: designing automation, deploying AI agents, and raising the bar for what modern procurement operations looks like.
The procurement domain can be learned by the right person; the operating instincts cannot. We're looking for someone with the curiosity, adaptability, and judgment to step into a complex function, build trust quickly, and deliver. Over time, this role can flex into broader Finance and Business Operations work as priorities evolve. It reports to the Sr. Manager, Procurement and is part of the broader Finance Operations org.

Own and elevate day-to-day procurement operations
Run vendor onboarding, intake triage, PO creation, and urgent approval coordination across business, finance, legal, security, and IT with minimal oversight
Take active responsibility across the procure-to-pay cycle, partnering with Accounts Payable on vendor master data quality, PO accuracy, and dispute resolution
Design and scale fast-buy processes (P-card programs, catalogs, self-service paths) that take repetitive purchases out of the queue
Lead contract redlining
Own redline of SOWs and Order Forms for commercial terms, partnering with Legal on non-commercial terms
Re-architect procurement with AI
Identify where AI agents, automation, and Airtable-native tooling can replace manual work, then build, deploy, iterate, and set the standard for how the team adopts agentic systems
Design multi-step workflows that delegate routine tasks to AI rather than just speeding up the human version of them
Verify AI output with rigor: anticipate failure modes, build in checks, and define how the team distinguishes trustworthy output from slop
Build reusable tools, templates, and playbooks that raise the quality bar across the company, not just your own output
Flex into broader operations work
Take on cross-functional Finance Operations projects as priorities shift, scoped to grow beyond procurement for someone with the instincts to wear whatever hat the business needs

6+ years across procurement, sourcing, finance operations, business operations, program management, or an equivalent function. Procurement experience is a plus; a strong cross-functional operator who picks up complex domains quickly is equally compelling
Comfortable navigating ambiguity, biased toward taking the first swing over over-planning, with genuine curiosity for unfamiliar problems
Meets stakeholders where they are and earns structure by delivering, scanning for friction and bridging gaps no one else owns
Strong written and verbal communicator who can adjust register for the audience, whether that is the CFO, vendor counsel, or a teammate in Slack
Directs AI tools rather than just using them, producing higher-quality work because of how AI is used, and can point to specific examples of work that couldn't have been done a year ago
Has built reusable tools, templates, or workflows that others adopted, raising someone else's quality bar through what was built
Experience with procurement, financial, and legal systems (Zip, Coupa, Workday, Ironclad CLM) or a clear track record of picking up new tooling quickly
Excited that this role can grow into broader Finance or Business Operations work
Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience

Power the Pacific Northwest: Shape the Future of Clean Energy as our Internal Operations Leader The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) is at the heart of the Pacific Northwest's clean energy lifeline, operating one of the nation's largest and most reliable high-voltage transmission grids.

Behind the physical lines and substations that power millions of homes and businesses is a dedicated engine of operational excellence. As the Internal Operations Manager, you will step into a pivotal, high-visibility role as the operational "chief of staff" for our Construction and Maintenance Services division.

You will lead the critical planning, budgeting, and administrative strategies that empower our field crews to execute grid-modernization projects safely, efficiently, and on schedule.

If you are a strategic thinker who thrives at the intersection of team leadership, resource optimization, and high-impact project support, this is your opportunity to drive real-world impact on the future of clean energy.

Key Responsibilities of the Role Here are the eight most impactful and rewarding duties of this position, redesigned to highlight your strategic influence and leadership impact: Serve as a Chief Strategic Advisor Directly partner with senior executive leadership to shape, implement, and evaluate regional grid construction and maintenance programs.

In this trusted advisory role, you will provide critical data, analytical insights, and strategic recommendations that influence high-level decision-making. Lead, Mentor, and Empower a High-Performing Team Provide direct leadership and oversight to a talented team of professional and administrative experts.

You will establish performance standards, foster professional growth, resolve workplace disputes, and champion a collaborative, inclusive culture built on mutual respect and shared success. Drive Multi-Million-Dollar Portfolio and Budget Planning Take ownership of long-range program planning, budgeting, and workload scheduling.

You will oversee resource allocations and monitor third-party contractor portfolios to ensure critical infrastructure projects are executed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

Build and Navigate Key Stakeholder Alliances Represent the agency in critical negotiations and collaborative efforts with executive leaders, federal and state partners, regional public and private utility providers, and manufacturing representatives. You will serve as a key broker in aligning regional interests and securing essential resources.

Champion Process Innovation and Efficiency Identify and eliminate operational bottlenecks. You will foster a forward-thinking, cost-conscious, and results-oriented environment by designing and implementing modern, streamlined workflows that continuously improve operational delivery.

Navigate Regulatory Compliance and Grid Modernization Interpret and apply national energy guidelines and utility performance standards (including NERC and FERC regulations). You will ensure that all planning, construction, and asset-management initiatives align with national compliance frameworks to protect grid reliability.

Shape Long-Term Workforce and Contract Strategies Determine long-range staffing requirements and make high-level decisions on whether to leverage internal personnel or contract work out to private partners. You will design annual and long-range strategic work plans that align administrative resources with field operations.

Champion Safety and Field Readiness Oversee and coordinate critical technical craft and safety training programs across the Pacific Northwest. You will ensure that field personnel are fully equipped, certified, and compliant with safety standards to successfully execute high-risk construction projects.
SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: A qualified candidate's online application and resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level [GS-12] in the Federal service.

Specialized experience for this position is defined as: 1) Providing program management and analytical advisory services to management in the areas of work planning, scheduling, budgeting, and cost analysis within a utility, construction, production, or maintenance organization; and 2) Performing lead or supervisory duties such as planning and assigning work, establishing performance standards, and resolving administrative or employee grievances.

"Experience" refers to paid and unpaid experience. Examples of qualifying unpaid experience may include: volunteer work done through National Service programs (such as Peace Corps and AmeriCorps); as well as work for other community-based philanthropic and social organizations.

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills; and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Time-in-Grade: Current Federal employees must meet time-in-grade requirements by the closing date of this announcement to receive consideration. CTAP/ICTAP candidates: To be considered "well qualified" you must meet all of the requirements as described in this section.

You must meet all qualifications and eligibility requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

The primary function of the position involves work as a business and operational manager of the franchise restaurant for planning, directing, organizing and business resources to successfully operate and support the installation commander's quality of life programs.

Duties and Responsibilities: Responsible for the economic and efficient management of the franchise restaurant. Ensures all food and beverages meet Air Force (AF) and franchise standards in taste, temperature, freshness, and appearance while adhering to AF and franchise programs and policies.

Effectively supervises managers, staff, and oversees recruitment and training of all personnel. Keep team members current on ongoing/upcoming promotions, business trends, and safety issues. Ensures adherence to all health and safety standards. Estimates food and beverage costs and ensures costs are maintained within established parameters.

Purchases and maintains supplies, equipment, food and beverages at a level that meets current business trends and minimizes waste. Establishes financial goals, prepares budgets, analyzes financial results, maintains solid financial condition, and keeps expenditures within budgetary limits.

Implements higher-level directives, franchise requirements and contract specifications. Formulates procedures and programs to ensure high standards of food and beverage operations consistent with AF and franchise expectations. Strict adherence to policies in customer service.

Manages real property resources and provides expert advice on renovations, improvements, and any required construction in compliance with AF and franchise standards. Investigates and resolves food and beverage quality and service complaints. Implements, monitors, reviews, and evaluates menu items, food production, and food service.

Develops and implements marketing strategies and special events to maintain market share and grow customer base. Establishes and monitors a cleaning and preventative maintenance program for facilities, equipment and vehicles.

Establishes an internal performance management system to ensure proper assignments and reviews evaluation of employee performance. Administers internal control system to preclude or minimize the potential for fraud, waste, and abuse. Arranges for equipment repairs and other services as required.

Complies with EEO concepts and security directives and maintains an appropriate work environment. Communicates ideas, contributions, trends and occurrences to other subordinate supervisors, other franchise locations and HQ AFSVC.

Qualifying Experience: Experience that shows progressively responsible administrative, professional, technical or other work which has provided a general knowledge of management principles and practices, OR progressively responsible experience in the functions managed by a manager of a full-service restaurant.

In addition to general experience, applicant must have specialized experience gained in the operation or management of a government, institutional or civilian restaurant. Experience working in a management role with a name brand casual dining restaurant is preferred.

Professional certification and/or accreditation in hospitality professional management areas is highly desirable. You will be evaluated on the basis of your level of competency in the following areas:

A World-Changing Company

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

As a Site Reliability Operations Analyst you are the engine behind Palantir deployments. You are responsible for crafting, implementing and executing processes to streamline workflows and reduce friction. You track and stabilise projects, remove roadblocks, and anticipate customer needs to free up our engineers to focus their time and attention on the technical problems they are best equipped to solve.

This position requires a combination of project management, process optimisation, and execution skills. You are a person who loves fixing problems and always embraces the best idea, even when it is not your own.

Work on many different types of problems and challenges. You might be supporting a deployment at a large, global customer one day, and jetting off across the world to help out with a new pilot project the next.
Be the first responders when things go wrong. Even if a problem is outside your area of expertise, you make the first move to fix it, and only ask for help when we’ve exhausted all that we can possibly do.
Craft and implement process to reduce friction and enable all team members to spend their time on what they do best.
Think creatively, work collaboratively, and do whatever it takes to get the job done.

What We Value

Extraordinary judgment and composure in high-pressure situations.
A creative approach to project management centered around lightweight frameworks that enable rapid iteration and low-overhead methods of keeping our customers informed.
Proven track record of developing effective and collaborative relationships with customers.
Meticulous attention to detail, including maintaining accurate records and diligently tracking key project metrics.
Enthusiasm for working on site with customers and/or supporting internal projects and senior leadership, bringing order and efficiency to critical internal initiatives.

What We Require

Ability to travel 25-75%, varies by location and team.
3+ years of project/program management experience, preferably in a fast-paced or dynamic environment.
Security clearance or the ability to obtain a clearance.
Swedish language fluency.

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

Docker’s event portfolio - flagship conferences, developer roadshows, digital events, and community activations - is how Docker shows up in the world and turns developer enthusiasm into enterprise pipeline. As the portfolio grows, operational excellence is what lets it scale without added risk or complexity.
As a Senior Event Operations Manager , you will own the operational execution of that portfolio. Success in this role is operational: events are delivered smoothly and consistently across the portfolio, teams have clear planning processes and execution frameworks to work from, and operational risks are identified early and resolved quickly. Above all, programs are able to grow and scale without increasing complexity, because the systems, playbooks, and budgets you build absorb that growth.

Own operational execution across the event portfolio - major conferences, developer roadshows, digital events, and community activations - managing timelines, project plans, and execution milestones across multiple concurrent events, and keeping them on schedule, on budget, and aligned to internal goals.
Maintain a master event calendar that coordinates timing, resourcing, and dependencies across programs.
Manage event registration, attendee experience, and lead capture and badging across the portfolio.
Build scalable event operations: repeatable planning templates, run-of-show frameworks, and operational playbooks, continuously simplifying and improving execution over time.
Own the event technology stack (registration, mobile apps, lead retrieval) and ensure data flows cleanly into marketing and sales systems.
Manage vendors and logistics: agencies, venues, production vendors, and internal teams, including contract execution, budget tracking, shipping, production schedules, and onsite readiness.

Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product Marketing, Developer Relations, Field Marketing, and Sales, translating program goals into clear operational plans.
Operationalize developer-focused programs - roadshows, community activations, and flagship conference experiences - and build frameworks that let them expand to additional markets over time.
Track event KPIs and pipeline/ROI, run post-event debriefs, and lead reconciliation and timely handoff to sales.
Provide operational and logistics support to Field Marketing across regional events, roadshows, and third-party/sponsored events, including sponsorship deliverables, booth and presence logistics, and lead retrieval.

6+ years in full-time, professional event management, event operations, and/or experiential program management.
Strong project management skills, with a track record coordinating complex programs across multiple stakeholders and concurrent events without losing attention to detail.
Must have the ability to travel 35% of the time across North America, with potential for international travel

What to Expect
First 30 Days
Immerse in Docker’s event portfolio, the master calendar, the event tech stack, and current vendor and agency relationships.
Audit live programs and operational processes; identify where timelines, budgets, and handoffs carry the most risk.
Build working relationships with the Director of Events, Field Marketing, Product Marketing, Developer Relations, and Sales.

First 90 Days
Stand up or refine repeatable planning templates, run-of-show frameworks, and operational playbooks across the portfolio.

Deliver a flagship event or roadshow end to end, on schedule and on budget, with clean lead capture and sales handoff.
Establish a post-event debrief and KPI/ROI reporting cadence that informs future planning and investment.
One-Year Outlook
Run an event operations function that scales with the portfolio without adding risk or complexity.
Own end-to-end budgets and vendor relationships with reliable reconciliation and reporting.
Expand developer-focused programs to additional markets on repeatable frameworks.
Be the operational backbone the events and field marketing teams rely on for consistent, high-quality execution.

This role is expected to proactively surface revenue risks, highlight performance drivers, and improve how the organization plans, inspects, and delivers revenue—not simply report on outcomes. This role offers location flexibility and is open to candidates across the United States.

A day in the life: The AI Operations Manager is the operating system behind the Innovation team. You administer the company's enterprise AI platforms, keep the SVP and the team's initiatives moving in sync, keep the roadmap current, and act as an early-warning system for what is changing at the AI frontier.

Early on the work is operations-heavy; your strategic voice is expected to grow as you automate the operations down. You are a force multiplier, not a support function.

Responsibilities: - Administer the company's enterprise AI platforms - Claude Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise, Gemini, and new tools as we adopt them - covering provisioning, access, RBAC, usage governance, and billing, and automate that administration down over time. - Keep the SVP of Innovation organized and ahead of schedule through prioritization, prep, and follow-through - you catch what would otherwise slip before it does. - Run the Innovation team's weekly operating rhythm and keep the roadmap current and trusted at all times. - Produce a weekly AI intelligence brief on what is shipping at the frontier and what the team should test. - Bring a point of view into strategy conversations and grow into a genuine strategic voice for the team. - Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department. - Other applicable or related duties as assigned.

Role Requirements: 2-4 years of experience; early-career with an unusually high ceiling and a fast learning rate. AI-native - you use Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini daily and have real intuition for what they can and cannot do. This is the non-negotiable bar. A strong organizer who makes chaos legible and closes loops without being chased.

A clear writer and systems thinker who holds a point of view. Comfortable being the least experienced person in the room and still adding value. Meaningful daily overlap with U.S. Pacific hours (LATAM timezones ideal); remote, open to international candidates. Bonus: you have built something with AI - an agent, a workflow, or a shipped side project.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) - Enterprise AI platform access and provisioning requests resolved within one business day, fully documented. - Admin time trending down quarter over quarter as workflows get automated. - Weekly AI intelligence brief shipped on time, every week. - Roadmap accurate and current at any given moment - never a scramble to update it. - Zero missed commitments or dropped follow-ups traceable to coordination gaps.

Most Important Things (MITs) - Be the reason the Innovation team's operations run without friction. - Keep the SVP focused on the highest-leverage work by owning everything beneath it. - Turn AI platform administration into a system that mostly runs itself. - Act as an early-warning system for what is changing in AI - surface it before it is obvious. - Earn a real voice in strategy by being right, useful, and fast.

Own CPU and cost metrics.

ElevenLabs is scaling fast – new enterprise customers, new products, new markets. The Billing Operations Specialist is the person who makes sure every deal that closes is reflected correctly in our systems.
This is an operational ownership role, sitting at the intersection of Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Engineering – responsible for the full billing lifecycle of our enterprise accounts, from provisioning a new customer on day one to cleanly closing out a churned account. You'll resolve discrepancies before customers notice them, catch configuration drift before it becomes a revenue problem, and build the processes that make billing feel invisible to everyone else.
The ideal person is someone who is obsessive about accuracy, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and energized (not frustrated) by the complexity of managing billing at scale across hundreds of accounts.
Provisioning
Translate closed-won deals from Salesforce into correctly configured subscriptions in our billing platforms, such as Stripe – pricing plan, billing interval, contract start date, trial periods, discounts
Own the reconciliation between executed order forms and what's been requested for provisioning; work with Sales and Legal to resolve any gaps
Partner with Engineering to identify automation opportunities and build guardrails that make provisioning faster and more accurate over time
Subscription & account management
Process mid-cycle changes and manage renewal mechanics – upgrades, downgrades, seat changes, plan switches, and so on.
Handle offboarding cleanly: close subscriptions, issue final invoices or credits, ensure no residual billing
Resolve invoice discrepancies raised by customers or flagged by the Customer Success team – incorrect amounts, missing credits, misapplied discounts
Revenue integrity
Run periodic audits of active subscriptions to verify billing matches contracted terms
Identify and remediate ghost subscriptions, duplicate customers, and orphaned invoices
Support month-end and quarter-end close by reconciling billing platforms with Finance's records
Surface pricing or configuration anomalies to relevant teams.
Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required.

As the Senior Renewal Operations at GitLab, you will own the operational engine behind our renewals motion. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Sales & CX Operations, you will be the person the business turns to on anything that touches renewal timing, renewal forecasting, subscription data, or the mechanics of getting a renewal quoted and closed.

You will partner closely with Renewals and Customer Success leadership, Sales, Finance, and Revenue Technology to make the renewal motion predictable, measurable, and efficient at scale.
This is a senior individual contributor role. You will lead through depth of ownership and influence rather than through direct reports, setting the standard in your domain and driving work that others across the revenue organization depend on.
This is a role for a sharp, curious operator who thrives in ambiguity, connects dots across teams, and moves quickly from problem to solution. You will work in an all-remote, values-driven environment where documentation, iteration, and cross-functional partnership are core to how we work.

Own the renewal forecast and the operating cadence around it, including forecast methodology, accuracy tracking, and the reviews that leadership relies on.
Run the operational rhythm of the renewal business
Safeguard the integrity of renewal and subscription data so that retention reporting is trusted across Sales, Customer Success, and Finance.
Define and maintain retention reporting, including gross and net retention, churn and downgrade analysis, and the drivers behind each.
Translate ambiguous business questions from leadership into clear problem statements, then drive them to resolution through process, reporting, or systems changes.
Partner with Revenue Technology and Revenue Analytics to evolve the systems, data, and reporting that carry the renewal motion, writing the requirements and validating what gets built.
Support planning cycles for the renewals organization, including segmentation, coverage models, capacity modeling, and target setting.
Build cross-functional alignment with Sales, Finance, and other Revenue Strategy & Operations teams to operationalize go-to-market changes that affect renewals.
Raise the operating standard in your domain by documenting the process, mentoring others on how the motion works, and contributing to broader Revenue Operations initiatives where the renewals perspective is needed.

5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Renewals Operations, management consulting, strategy, or a similar analytical and problem-solving role.
Hands-on experience with a subscription renewal motion, including renewal forecasting, retention reporting, and the contractual and process mechanics that govern how renewals close.
Strong critical thinking and structured problem solving. You can break down ambiguous problems into clear workstreams and move them forward.
Strong quantitative and data analysis skills. You are highly proficient in Excel or Sheets and comfortable building a model from scratch and validating your own numbers. SQL is a plus.
Systems thinking. You understand how a change in one part of the go-to-market motion ripples through to others, including how the CRM, subscription or entitlement records, quoting, and billing relate to one another, and you design solutions accordingly.
Fluency in the sales process and the customer journey, with a clear view of where renewals sit within it.
Bias toward execution. You move from analysis to action quickly and follow through to outcomes that stick.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills. You build trust with stakeholders at all levels, including field teams and senior leadership, and influence without direct authority.
Curiosity and aptitude to pick up new domains, tools, and concepts quickly. We care more about how you think than which specific tools you have used.
Comfort operating in a scaling environment where not everything is defined and structure must be created.

The Sales and CX Operations team sits within the Revenue Operations function at GitLab and is responsible for the processes, data standards, and operational programs that enable our Sales, Customer Success, and Renewals teams to operate at scale.
This team works in close partnership with other Revenue Strategy & Operations teams, CX field teams, Finance, and Sales to ensure operational alignment across the full customer lifecycle. We value clear documentation, thoughtful iteration, and practical solutions that help our go-to-market teams move with confidence and clarity.

Storyblok is hiring a Deal Operations Manager to build the operating workflow for how deals are structured, reviewed, approved, executed, and handed off across quote-to-cash.

The role supports Sales on deal construction and deal design strategy, coordinates Legal execution, partners with Finance on revenue recognition readiness, and turns pricing, packaging, and NPI decisions into field-ready operating process.

Sitting within Revenue Operations, this role works across Sales, Sales Leadership, Finance, Legal, Deal Strategy, Systems, Order Management, Security, Customer Success, and Product / Packaging to make approval-ready deals faster and downstream defects lower.

Deal operations workflow and process
Build the global deal operations workflow for intake, routing, approval readiness, SLAs, escalation paths, and exception handling.
Own approval readiness in DealHub CPQ, including required fields, quote quality checks, approval context, discount rationale, and downstream handoff inputs.
Maintain practical process documentation, templates, and decision rules so Sales can move standard deals through documented paths.
Deal construction and design strategy support
Support Sales and Sales Leadership on deal construction across new business, renewal, expansion, multi-year, ramped, multi-product, and non-standard commercial requests.
Translate deal strategy into approval-ready constructs with clear value exchange, risk flags, concession logic, billing terms, contract timing, and implementation assumptions.
Partner with Deal Strategy, Customer Success, Product / Packaging, and Finance when commercial design affects retention, expansion, product adoption, or reporting.
Legal execution and Finance revenue recognition readiness
Engage Legal early on non-standard terms, contract language, execution path, risk ownership, and customer-requested changes.
Coordinate with Finance on revenue recognition inputs, billing terms, payment terms, start dates, product lines, order form clarity, and required approval evidence.
Maintain pre-signature checks for deals with rev rec, billing, custom terms, or product readiness risk.
Pricing, packaging, NPI, and DealHub CPQ rollout
Participate in pricing and packaging execution and strategy support so decisions can be turned into field process, DealHub CPQ logic, approval paths, and reporting readiness.
Support NPI rollout by defining deal rules, quote requirements, launch constraints, fallback paths, and field guidance for early transactions.
Track whether pricing, packaging, or NPI changes create quote exceptions, approval confusion, billing defects, or customer handoff issues.
Quote-to-cash quality, cadence, and continuous improvement
Own the operating handoff from approved quote to order, billing, commissions, reporting, and customer lifecycle records.
Run the deal operations cadence with KPI packs, defect logs, root-cause reviews, action owners, and process improvements.
Identify automation and AI use cases tied to intake, routing, approval summaries, quote checks, documentation, and measurable cycle-time reduction.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years in Deal Desk, Deal Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a comparable commercial operations role, ideally in B2B SaaS.
Hands-on experience with CPQ tooling (DealHub or comparable) and quote-to-cash / lead-to-cash processes.
Demonstrated experience structuring and reviewing non-standard deals (multi-year, ramped, expansion, multi-product) and partnering with Sales on deal construction.
Working knowledge of revenue recognition concepts, billing and order processes, and coordinating contract execution with Legal and Finance.
Experience building scalable process, documentation, SLAs, and operating cadences (KPI reviews, defect logs, root-cause analysis).
Strong analytical skills and comfort working in Salesforce and reporting tools.
Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

Commercial acumen: structures sound deals that balance customer value, risk, and revenue / margin outcomes.
Process design: builds clear, scalable workflows, SLAs, and escalation paths that scale beyond manual effort.
Cross-functional coordination: aligns Sales, Legal, Finance, Systems, Order Management, and CS around complete deal packages.
Attention to detail: enforces quote quality, approval readiness, and pre-signature checks to reduce downstream defects.
Operating rigor: runs cadences with KPIs, defect logs, and root-cause reviews that drive measurable improvement.
Influence without authority: guides Sales toward documented paths and sound commercial discipline.
Communication: produces clear guidance, decision rules, and leadership-ready operating views.
Continuous improvement and automation mindset: identifies automation / AI use cases that reduce cycle time and rework.

Role

Sword Health is seeking a Partner Operations Manager to own the operational backbone of a portfolio of partner relationships. This is an individual-contributor role with direct accountability for how partnerships actually run day to day: configuration, billing, integrations, implementations, escalations, and account business reviews.

The right candidate brings the operational rigor to run complex, multi-stakeholder partnerships end to end, and the judgment to know when to resolve something directly and when to escalate it.

AI Proficiency at Sword Health
AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword Health. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.
Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity
Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team
Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale
Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.
What you'll be doing
Own the operational execution for an assigned partner portfolio: configuration, file feeds, billing, integrations, and reporting.
Lead implementations and ongoing operational work for new and existing partners, coordinating internally to keep commitments on track.
Run partner-level escalations to resolution, looping in Partner Sales, Product, Client and Data Operations, or Customer Success as needed.
Own account/partner business review prep and delivery for your portfolio.
Serve as the day-to-day operational point of contact for partner and partner-customer stakeholders.
Partner closely with Partner Sales, Client and Data Operations, Product, and Customer Success to keep partnerships running smoothly and flag risk early.
What you need to have
Experience owning complex operational workflows for external partners or clients: billing, integrations, data or file feeds, or similar systems-level work.
Comfort operating across ambiguity with multiple internal and external stakeholders, without needing a defined playbook for every situation.
Strong analytical and critical thinking foundation: you reason from facts, synthesize clearly, and communicate with brevity.
High initiative and sound judgment: you identify what matters and act without waiting to be directed.
A track record of building trust directly with external partners or customers, not just internal stakeholders.
Direct, ongoing accountability for an external-facing relationship (client, partner, or vendor) as a standing responsibility, not a one-time project -- this is what separates someone ready for live, recurring partner ops from a general internal-ops background.
What we'd love to see
Experience in health plans, digital health, or the partner/benefits ecosystem.
Familiarity with partner or channel operations models (implementation, contracting handoff, ongoing account management).
Experience with billing, data integration, or technical operations in a client- or partner-facing role.

Global Markets Global Valuation Group (GVG) is a division of Global Banking & Markets (GBAM) Finance responsible for providing valuation and independent price verification methodology support to Business Finance & Control (BFC) teams for execution of IPV, calculation of valuation adjustments and prudential valuation adjustments.

The team is also responsible for reporting and governance across all valuation processes. Additionally, the team works on a number of regulatory deliverables related to valuations and drives the overall valuation control automation agenda in partnership with Technology and other stakeholders.
The team works closely with front office, middle office, traders, business finance controllers, market risk, quantitative risk and technology teams to drive the control agenda across the business.
Job Description
We are looking to hire a seasoned leader in the Global Valuations Group to project manage number of regulatory deliverables for GM & GCIB Finance organization. The person will be responsible for planning of regulatory engagement through the cycle from early notification to remediation phases.

They will be required to manage stakeholders from different divisions within the bank to ensure that right responsibilities are allocated to right teams and the teams deliver on those in a timely fashion.

They will be helping the team put together regulatory submissions, will track progress and milestones, escalate risks as needed and facilitate issue resolution.
Given this role will be part of the valuations group and will involve interactions with senior management of technical functions, we need the person to have a deep understanding of all regulatory guidelines (like CCAR stress testing, Prudential Valuation guidelines from a PRA and ECB perspective, ICAAP etc.).

Additionally, they should also have a good knowledge of financial products and their valuations. Ideally, this role will best suit a person who has already been managing such technical regulatory projects for multiple years.

Planning of regulatory engagement through the cycle from early notification to remediation phases
Stakeholder management including ensuring adequate ownership and responsibilities of the different parties involved
End to end project management of regulatory deliverables including putting together submissions, tracking of progress and milestone, escalation of risks and issues and facilitating issue resolution
Providing upward communication on project progress to CFO senior leadership
Ensuring high quality outputs from SME team by setting standards and providing guidance on expectations
Interpret regulatory changes and engage with CFO teams to perform impact assessments and drive change so that we are compliant with the new changes
Put together technical presentations in partnership with CFO teams
Drive the operational excellence agenda, ensuring process standardization, controls maturity, and continuous improvement across business-critical activities.
Drive valuation related projects such as market data assessment for various asset classes, back-testing of results as per regulatory guidelines, drive intra-month prices testing of results etc.
Manage the overall Model governance process for valuation related models
Identify, document, and assess AI opportunities; collaborate with Technology, FLUs, and SMEs to evaluate feasibility, ROI, risk considerations, and operational impact.
Ensure adherence to AI use-case governance, including risk alignment, model-development documentation, compliance with enterprise AI policies, and responsible-AI practices.
Govern technology and change portfolios, ensuring transparency, prioritization, sequencing, and delivery accountability.

Graduate/ Postgraduate in Finance/Management from Tier I/II institute

Strong communication skills to be able to present to a highly technical and senior audience

Experience working with Technology partners on architecture discussions, feasibility assessments, and solution design
Additional skills

Hands on experience in managing AI projects at large scale

Prior experience performing market data assessment and working with vendors on assessing quality of data

Deep understanding of MAS Risk-Based Capital (RBC) frameworks, SF(LCB)R requirements, and capital requirements for broker-dealers in Singapore.
5+ years of experience in financial operations or regulatory reporting within a broker-dealer or financial institution in Singapore.
Experience managing back-office ledger systems, Swift/API data feeds, and reporting automation using tools like Excel/Google Sheets (SQL or data visualization tools like Superset are a plus).
Strong self-starter attitude with proven success operating independently in a fast-paced environment and managing time-sensitive regulatory deadlines (e.g., 12:00 PM SGT daily deliverables).

Field Operations Manager Location Remote (U.S.) with occasional travel to customer sites, TurbineOne facilities, demonstrations, and operational events as required. About TurbineOne TurbineOne is building Mission-AI for the Frontlines.

Our Frontline Perception System (FPS) helps military and national security operators detect threats, accelerate decision-making, and unlock the power of AI at the tactical edge. We endeavor to build mission-valuable products in command and control, autonomy, and AI-enabled mission systems.

We partner directly with frontline users to deliver mission-ready capabilities that work in real-world environments where speed, trust, reliability, and operational resilience matter most. Our team is composed of experienced technologists, veterans, and operators committed to advancing national security through responsible innovation.

The Role The Field Operations Manager owns the operational systems that make Field Engineering deployable, repeatable, and scalable. This is a builder role; you will start as an Individual Contributor (IC) with extended team support, responsible for defining the operational models and discipline.

Over time, you will build and lead a team to perform these functions. You will partner closely with Field Engineering, Mission Operations, Product, Engineering, Security, BD, and leadership to ensure every field engagement has the right people, equipment, information, and operating cadence to succeed. Core Responsibility Areas

Field Engagement Operations: Own the end-to-end operational workflow for Field Engineering from resourcing and readiness to execution and closeout. Maintain the field engagement tracker, validate upcoming requests, and drive pre-deployment planning discipline.

Field Hardware: Own the operational readiness of field hardware. Coordinate imaging, configuration, software versioning, testing, and shipping for deployments and demos. Maintain standard loadouts and coordinate with Engineering/IT/DevOps.

Field Asset Management: Create and maintain the asset-management system. Track inventory, custody, location, status, and lifecycle management for all field gear.

Field Knowledge Management: Own the field knowledge base. Maintain SOPs, checklists, templates, and AARs. Ensure lessons learned are captured and reusable.

Field Communications: Own communication rhythms. Translate product updates into field-relevant guidance, coordinate daily SITREPs, and provide operational updates to leadership.

Field Enablement: Own the Field Engineering readiness model. Build onboarding pathways, define readiness requirements, and run enablement sessions and assessments to ensure FEs are prepared for mission types and hardware loadouts.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
4+ years of experience in Field Operations, Technical Enablement, Customer Success, or Systems Engineering, with a specific focus on building and scaling operational systems.
2+ years of experience leading or managing teams (this role transitions from a hands-on IC builder to a team lead).

About Maneva Maneva is an AI services company founded by a former Google DeepMind researcher, focused on transforming manufacturing operations through advanced AI. We enable autonomous factory operation and optimization by generating AI-driven actions and insights using off-the-shelf hardware or existing vision systems.

We've grown rapidly and are well-funded, technically exceptional, and mission-driven. As we grow, we're building a people-first culture that attracts, develops, and retains world-class talent. Role Overview Maneva is seeking a People & Business Operations Manager to build and lead our people operations function at a critical stage of growth.

This role sits at the intersection of employee lifecycle management, governance, business operations, and culture.

You'll own performance management infrastructure, compensation and benefits administration, employee relations, U.S. state-level employment compliance as we expand our U.S. footprint, and will help drive the initiatives of the strategy and business operations team.

You'll be responsible for building the systems that let us hire, develop, and retain great people as we continue our fast expansion. You'll work closely with the Talent Manager, Finance, Business Operations, and the broader executive leadership team, and act as a trusted advisor to the CEO and leadership team on people matters.

Key Responsibilities U.S. Employment Compliance Own state-by-state compliance as Maneva expands its U.S. employee base: tax registration, payroll setup, mandatory workplace posters, and required employee notices, all of which vary by state.

Build and maintain a repeatable process for evaluating new-state requirements as hiring expands, rather than handling each state reactively. Partner with Rippling, outside counsel, and Finance to ensure payroll, tax, and notice obligations are met on schedule for every state in which Maneva has employees.

Serve as Maneva 's go-to internal expert on U.S. state employment law as it applies to a distributed, remote-first workforce. Performance Management & Levelling Design and execute performance review cycles (6-month and annual) across the organization, tailored to company growth stage and business needs.

Own and maintain levelling frameworks across engineering (IC1–IC6) and non-technical roles; define competencies, expectations, and progression criteria, building on the framework already in place. Partner with department heads and the Talent Manager to calibrate performance data and inform talent decisions.

Design and facilitate manager training on feedback, goal-setting, and performance conversations. Maintain performance documentation and analytics to inform strategic people decisions. Compensation Administration Own day-to-day execution of compensation administration across all job levels and geographies; maintain salary bands.

Execute variable/commission plans for sales and other roles; ensure alignment with business goals. Execute ROE submissions, payroll adjustments, and comp/commission payouts, routing every payout through Finance for cost sign-off. Handle market increases, retention bonuses, and compensation requests with appropriate approvals.

The Bureau of Human Resources proposes a structured, project-based student volunteer initiative within the Records and Information Management branch of the Office of Talent Services (HR/TS/RIM) at the U.S. Department of State.

This initiative directly supports the Presidential Management Agenda and Department priorities related to standardizing systems, eliminating data silos, and reducing wasteful processes.

Student volunteers will contribute to clearly defined, outcome-driven projects, including the documentation of standard procedures, conducting process mapping and proposing innovative modernizations, and updating SharePoint and ServiceNow systems with relevant information.

These efforts address a legitimate agency need to increase efficiencies as well as improve the usability, discoverability, and preservation of operational documents while supporting broader federal data and records management objectives.

The project is designed to align with student learning objectives by providing hands-on experience in process mapping and improvement, writing in Plain Language, lean management practices, and digital records management, while strengthening technical, analytical, and critical thinking skills.

Work will be scoped for completion within a single academic term and will include structured milestones such as onboarding and training, midpoint progress reviews, and final deliverables.

Deliverables may include process documentation, digitized Standard Operating Procedures cataloged in web-based systems, and research summaries that can be operationalized by HR/TS/RIM staff.

Goal: Improve the clarity, consistency, and efficiency of HR/TS/RIM's standard operating procedures (SOPs) by reviewing, revising, and standardizing up to 10 priority SOP documents using Lean management principles, Plain Language best practices, and staff input.

Objectives: 1) By the end of the Spring 2027 semester, review up to 10 existing SOPs; consult with relevant staff and partners to identify process inefficiencies, lessons learned, and opportunities for improvement; research and apply appropriate Lean management principles to develop revised SOP draft. 2) By the end of the Spring 2027 semester, create a culminating presentation to HR/TS/RIM staff and leadership about insights and lessons learned from SOP review, including any recommendations for additional improvements and practice adoptions for the office gleaned from interactions with staff and reviewing source materials.

Deliverables: By the conclusion of the internship, finalize and upload all approved SOPs to the designated digital platform using the organization's standard template, ensuring each document is written in Plain Language, reflects current practices, and is organized for ease of use and future maintenance.

About SafeLease
At SafeLease , we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change. We believe the industry's biggest inefficiencies aren't technical problems — they're structural ones. And we're building the team to tackle them.

SafeLease is a profitable insurance business that designs, underwrites, and distributes specialty coverage for commercial property owners and their tenants. Most insurance companies either distribute products or bear the risk — we do both.

We back our policies with our own capital, which means we control the full stack: product design, tech, and the speed at which we move. That end-to-end ownership lets us offer customers real flexibility, saving time and money for more than 4,000 properties insured for billions in value nationwide.

We're a team of 70, growing over 100% annually, and we've done it without sacrificing profitability or culture. Here, you'll get high discretion and a wide aperture of problems to solve. We embrace the newest technologies, move fast together, and operate with the intensity of a small company where every person's work is visible.

If you're looking for a place to sharpen your craft alongside people who take their work seriously, you'll fit right in. About the role We're growing fast, launching new products, and running marketing across multiple brands and verticals at once, powered by a connected stack including HubSpot and Salesforce.

That means a lot of moving pieces: platforms that need to talk to each other, launches that need clear requirements before they kick off, and projects that need someone keeping an eye on the whole picture. This role is that person.

You'll make sure nothing falls through the cracks, turn messy requirements into clear specs, and look at our data to tell us what's actually working. If you like being the person who connects the dots across a growing company, this is a great seat to be in. What you'll do: Keep our systems connected
Keep HubSpot and Salesforce connected and working together (CRM, email/campaign tools, website, and others)

s.h: Build reporting that shows the team what's converting and why
s.t:
Shape how launches happen
Gather and document requirements from stakeholders ahead of any launch, campaign, or project, so teams start with clarity instead of guesswork
Translate marketing's needs into clear specs when something needs to be built by engineering or another team
Dig into current processes and performance data to find what's working and where we can do better

Track all active marketing projects and launches, keep timelines visible, and catch blockers before they become deadline problems
Be the person the team trusts to know where everything stands, without anyone having to ask
Be the go-to point of contact when marketing needs a technical build, and see it through to delivery

2-4 years of experience in business analysis, marketing operations, or a related role
Required: hands-on experience with HubSpot and Salesforce
A fast learner who picks up new platforms quickly and figures out how they connect to everything else

A knack for spotting problems in data or process and explaining them clearly to anyone, technical or not
The kind of organized that keeps multiple projects moving without anything slipping
Comfortable using AI tools (like Claude) to work faster and smarter
Why SafeLease ? The tech: Our prospects convert fast because we’re solving real problems and delivering serious value to commercial real estate owners. The team: We’re a team of seasoned pros and sharp operators who know how to move fast and build smart. High standards, low ego.

The stability: We’re well-funded, growing fast, and we make sure our team shares in that success with competitive pay and equity. The employee experience: We also offer unlimited PTO, full health benefits, flexible work setups, and the kind of culture where people want to show up to do their best work.

As Campaign Operations Manager, your mission will be to own the successful delivery and optimisation of digital advertising campaigns from initial planning through to post-campaign analysis.
You’ll ensure campaigns launch accurately, deliver against their objectives and provide an excellent experience for our clients and internal teams. You’ll proactively solve delivery challenges, identify opportunities to maximise revenue and use data to turn campaign performance into valuable insights.
Success in this role means consistently delivering high-quality campaigns while helping Campaign Operations become smarter, more efficient and increasingly scalable.

Own the end-to-end delivery of digital advertising campaigns, from planning and setup through to optimisation, reporting and post-campaign analysis.
Ensure campaigns are implemented accurately, launched on time and delivered in line with agreed objectives.
Monitor campaign performance and proactively optimise activity to improve delivery and results.
Troubleshoot campaign issues, resolve blockers and minimise delivery and revenue risk.
Produce high-quality campaign reports and post-campaign analysis decks that translate performance data into clear, actionable insights.
Present campaign performance, findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders and external clients when required.
Build strong working relationships with Sales, Product, Data, Marketing, Engineering and external partners.
Identify commercial opportunities, including campaign upweights, extensions and improvements that could deliver additional value for clients and Carwow.
Continuously review Campaign Operations processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy and scalability.
Support the adoption of automation, AI and new technology across Campaign Operations while maintaining strong quality-control standards.

Experience managing and delivering digital advertising campaigns within a publisher, media owner, agency or ad-tech environment.
Strong understanding of digital advertising operations, campaign setup, optimisation, delivery and reporting.
Experience using an ad server or campaign management platform, ideally Google Ad Manager.
Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, stakeholders and deadlines at the same time.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn campaign data into clear insights and recommendations.
A proactive approach to identifying risks, resolving problems and improving campaign performance.
Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering accurate, high-quality work.
Confident communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain campaign performance clearly.
A commercially minded approach, with an understanding of how effective campaign management supports revenue and client retention.
A collaborative, adaptable mindset and an interest in improving processes through technology, automation and AI.

Experience working within the automotive, publishing or digital media industry.
Knowledge of programmatic advertising, paid social, YouTube or off-site display campaigns.
Experience with demand-generation or lead-generation campaigns.
Familiarity with platforms such as DV360, Meta Ads Manager, Salesforce, Driftrock or audience-management platforms.
Previous involvement in process-improvement, automation or AI projects.

s.h: WHY THIS MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

Campaign Operations is a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, with responsibility for delivering commercially important campaigns against tight deadlines and changing priorities.

You’ll also work closely with different teams to find solutions and should be motivated to challenge and improve existing ways of working not simply follow established processes.
